concept: Review and integration: what bouncing back feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of feeling upset and trying again, focusing on what you can control, and learning from mistakes — which helps you most?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'resilience' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
